name: c-assistant
description: Personal travel assistant with a Web workspace, email assistance, and MAH integration.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @c-assistant/core build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/agent-adapters build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/connectors build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/travel-support build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/storage build && C_ASSISTANT_PORT=8877 concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server dev" "pnpm --filter @c-assistant/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @c-assistant/core build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/agent-adapters build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/connectors build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/travel-support build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/storage build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @c-assistant/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/agent-adapters typecheck && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/connectors typecheck && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/travel-support typecheck && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/storage typecheck && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server typecheck && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @c-assistant/core test && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/agent-adapters test && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/connectors test && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/travel-support test && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/storage test && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server test && pnpm test:mah-carrier && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server exec tsx --test ../../apps/web/src/*.test.ts && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server exec tsx --test ../../scripts/semantic-plan-structurer.test.ts && node --test scripts/local-launcher.test.mjs scripts/configure-google.test.mjs scripts/check-workspace.test.mjs scripts/prune-server-build.test.mjs scripts/travel-catalog-retirement.test.mjs scripts/email-review-entry-retirement.test.mjs
scripts.test:mah-carrier: pnpm --filter @c-assistant/storage build && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server build:mah-stage-validation && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server exec tsx --test src/mah-adaptive-stage-witness.test.ts src/mah-generation-runtime.test.ts src/mah-startup-recovery.test.ts src/isolated-generation-composition.test.ts ../../tests/mah-generation-integration.test.ts ../../tests/mah-stage-identity-integration.test.ts
scripts.test:local-launch: node --test scripts/local-launcher.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server exec tsx --test src/server-config.test.ts src/local-web-routes.test.ts src/server-lifecycle.test.ts
scripts.release:check: node scripts/release-check.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:supplemental && pnpm test:guarded-contracts
scripts.test:supplemental: pnpm --filter @c-assistant/server test:supplemental && node --test scripts/browser-test-isolation.test.mjs scripts/isolated-browser-owner.test.mjs scripts/inspect-mah-integration.test.mjs scripts/mah-scheduling-contract.test.mjs scripts/travel-types-retirement.test.mjs scripts/readonly-mechanism.test.mjs && node --test tests/browser/*.test.mjs && node --test scripts/travel-adjustment-contract.test.mjs
